_comment: LifegainHeliodCombo (2026-10-27), Martyr of Sands -- REVEAL BEFORE CASTING (the reviewer's probe). 2 Plains untapped (land drop used), Soul Warden + Martyr + Serra Ascendant (not sick); hand Soul's Attendant, Heliod, Ajani (3 WHITE); our life 20, opponent 6. The only kill: Martyr FIRST, X = 3 -> 29, THEN Soul's Attendant (Warden's trigger -> 30), Serra Ascendant 6/6 swings. Casting the Attendant first leaves X = 2 (20 + 1 + 6 = 27) and Serra a 1/1 -> no win. The outlet used to be a TRAILING activation only, so 'sacrifice, then cast' was unfindable at ANY budget (CLAUDE.md 'a budget may re-price work, it may not make a line unfindable'); the fix is the reveal outlet's POSITION twins (TurnSolver::RevealOutletSlot, AppendSubdecisionAxes). Same fixture at a FINITE budget (200 ms, d3): the twin is one extra root plan, so it is reached well inside the budget. BINDING: win T4, active life 36 = 20 + 9 (Martyr) + 1 (Warden on the Attendant) + 6 (Serra's lifelink).
